ai.name: Classification Accuracy Evaluator
ai.intro: Enter TP / FP / FN / TN from a confusion matrix to get accuracy, precision, recall and F1 for a binary classifier. Everything runs locally in the browser.

ai-10.name: CNN Feature Map Size Calculator
ai-10.intro: Enter input size, kernel size, stride and padding to compute the feature-map size after convolution or pooling. Built for CNN architecture design and receptive-field checks.

ai-11.name: Overfitting Diagnosis
ai-11.intro: Compare training and validation loss curves to tell overfitting from underfitting, and get targeted regularization and early-stopping advice.

ai-12.name: Data Augmentation Effective Sample Size
ai-12.intro: Estimate how many effective training samples a set of augmentation transforms actually adds, from the number of transforms and repeat factor. Use it to judge whether your dataset is large enough.

ai-13.name: Early Stopping Patience Estimator
ai-13.intro: Estimate a sensible early-stopping patience and the expected total training time from your observed training speed, before you launch a long run.

ai-14.name: Embedding Cosine Retrieval
ai-14.intro: Compute cosine similarity between a query vector and document vectors and rank the hits. Handy for RAG pipelines, semantic search and embedding debugging.

ai-15.name: Bayesian Posterior Probability
ai-15.intro: Update a posterior probability from a prior and a likelihood using Bayes theorem. Applies to medical screening, spam filtering and any belief-updating task.

ai-16.name: Ensemble Weighted Voting
ai-16.intro: Combine several models by weighted voting or weighted averaging to get an ensemble probability, and see how each model weight shifts the result.

ai-17.name: Prompt Context Window Usage
ai-17.intro: Count the tokens used by a multi-turn conversation and see what share of the model context window they occupy, so you know when to trim or compress history.

ai-4.name: Euclidean Distance Calculator
ai-4.intro: Compute the Euclidean distance and cosine similarity between two vectors. Used for feature similarity, nearest-neighbour checks and clustering analysis.

ai-5.name: Batch Size and Iterations Calculator
ai-5.intro: Enter dataset size and batch size to get the number of iterations per epoch, and sanity-check your training loop configuration.

ai-6.name: Neural Network Parameter Count Estimator
ai-6.intro: Estimate the parameter count of fully-connected and convolutional layers from layer widths, kernel sizes and channel counts. Useful for model sizing and memory budgeting.

ai-7.name: Confusion Matrix Metrics (MCC / FPR)
ai-7.intro: Enter TP / FP / FN / TN to get the Matthews correlation coefficient and false positive rate, two metrics that stay informative on imbalanced data.

ai-8.name: Gradient Descent Step Simulator
ai-8.intro: Simulate a single gradient descent update from the current parameter, gradient and learning rate, and watch how the loss moves toward the minimum.

ai-9.name: Information Gain (Gini / Entropy) Calculator
ai-9.intro: Measure the impurity drop before and after a binary split using the Gini index or entropy, to compare candidate features when building a decision tree.

ai-code-review.name: AI Code Review
ai-code-review.intro: Statically analyze JavaScript and TypeScript in the browser to surface common issues such as unused variables, unsafe equality and missing error handling.

ai-prompt-generator.name: AI Prompt Generator
ai-prompt-generator.intro: Pick a scenario, fill in the key fields, and assemble a well-structured professional prompt from proven templates.

ai-text-summarizer.name: AI Text Summarizer
ai-text-summarizer.intro: Extract the key sentences from Chinese text with TextRank, entirely in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.

attention-flops.name: Attention FLOPs Estimator
attention-flops.intro: Estimate the floating-point operations of a single attention layer and of the whole model from sequence length, head count and hidden size.

attention-head-dim.name: Attention Head Dimension Calculator
attention-head-dim.intro: Compute the per-head dimension and the single-layer parameter count of multi-head attention from hidden size and head count.

auc-rank.name: AUC Rank Estimator
auc-rank.intro: Estimate the area under the ROC curve from sample rank sums using the Mann-Whitney U approach, without drawing the curve.

augmentation-multiplier.name: Data Augmentation Multiplier
augmentation-multiplier.intro: Compute how much your training set grows after augmentation, from the number of transforms and the repeat factor.

best-epoch.name: Best Epoch Selector
best-epoch.intro: Paste per-epoch validation metrics and let the tool pick the best epoch, with an early-stopping recommendation for your next run.

cohens-kappa.name: Cohen's Kappa Coefficient
cohens-kappa.intro: Compute Cohen's kappa from two annotators' labels to measure agreement beyond chance. Standard for annotation QA and diagnostic consistency.

context-window.name: Context Window Usage Calculator
context-window.intro: Count the tokens in your prompt and expected completion and see how much of the model context window they consume.

cosine-similarity.name: Cosine Similarity Calculator
cosine-similarity.intro: Compute the cosine similarity of two vectors to measure how closely their directions agree. Common in text matching, recall and embedding comparison.

cross-entropy.name: Binary Cross-Entropy Loss Calculator
cross-entropy.intro: Compute binary cross-entropy loss from true labels and predicted probabilities to monitor training and spot badly calibrated outputs.

dropout.name: Dropout Expected Output Calculator
dropout.intro: Compute the expected output after dropout from the keep probability, plus the inference-time scaling factor that keeps train and test expectations aligned.

elbow-wcss.name: Elbow Method WCSS Drop Analyzer
elbow-wcss.intro: Enter within-cluster sum of squares for several values of k and find the elbow where adding clusters stops paying off.

epoch-time.name: Epoch Training Time Estimator
epoch-time.intro: Estimate the time for one epoch and for the whole run from per-step cost and step count. Useful for scheduling and compute budgeting.

flops.name: Model FLOPs Estimator
flops.intro: Estimate forward-pass FLOPs from fully-connected and convolutional layer dimensions, to compare model architectures before training.

grad-accumulation.name: Gradient Accumulation Steps Calculator
grad-accumulation.intro: Compute how many gradient accumulation steps you need to reach a target effective batch size when a single device batch is limited by memory.

image-classification.name: Local Image Classification
image-classification.intro: Classify an image with a pre-trained model running locally in the browser and see the Top-5 categories with probabilities. The image never leaves your device.

inference-throughput.name: Inference Throughput Estimator
inference-throughput.intro: Estimate inference throughput in tokens per second from the generated token count and end-to-end latency, for capacity planning.

k-means.name: K-Means Cost (Inertia) Estimator
k-means.intro: Estimate K-Means inertia, the within-cluster sum of squares, from sample points and centroids, to compare clustering configurations.

l1-l2.name: L1 / L2 Regularization Penalty Calculator
l1-l2.intro: Compute the L1 or L2 penalty added to the loss from your weights and regularization strength, and compare Lasso sparsity with Ridge shrinkage.

l1-l2-regularization.name: L1 / L2 Norm and Penalty Calculator
l1-l2-regularization.intro: Compute the L1 and L2 norms of a weight vector together with the matching penalty terms, to build intuition about sparsity and shrinkage.

lr-decay.name: Learning Rate Decay Calculator
lr-decay.intro: Compute the current learning rate under exponential or step decay schedules, for scheduler tuning and training-curve diagnosis.

lr-warmup.name: Learning Rate Warmup Steps Calculator
lr-warmup.intro: Compute how many steps a linear learning-rate warmup should cover, from total training steps and the warmup ratio, to keep early training stable.

min-max.name: Min-Max Feature Scaler
min-max.intro: Linearly rescale feature values into the [0, 1] or [-1, 1] range, the standard preprocessing step before distance-based models.

model-accuracy.name: Model Accuracy Calculator
model-accuracy.intro: Compute overall accuracy and per-class accuracy from a confusion matrix, for model evaluation and error analysis reports.

multi-agent-overhead.name: Multi-Agent Communication Overhead Estimator
multi-agent-overhead.intro: Estimate the communication overhead of a fully-connected multi-agent system from agent count and message frequency, before you commit to an architecture.

ocr.name: OCR Text Recognition
ocr.intro: Extract text from images locally in the browser, with Chinese and English support and multi-line layout. Results can be copied and edited.

precision-recall.name: Precision, Recall and F1 Calculator
precision-recall.intro: Compute precision, recall and F1 from true positives, false positives and false negatives. Useful for threshold selection on imbalanced data.

quantization-ratio.name: Quantization Compression Ratio Estimator
quantization-ratio.intro: Estimate the parameter and memory compression ratio when quantizing a model, for example from FP32 down to INT8, to plan deployment.

rag.name: RAG Retrieval Recall Calculator
rag.intro: Compute retrieval recall from the number of relevant documents and the number actually retrieved, to measure the coverage of your RAG retriever.

relu-leakyrelu.name: ReLU and LeakyReLU Activation Visualizer
relu-leakyrelu.intro: Compute and compare ReLU and LeakyReLU activations for a given input, with a visual plot that shows the dead-neuron problem.

rmse.name: MSE / RMSE / MAE / R-squared Calculator
rmse.intro: Evaluate regression quality from predictions and ground truth, reporting MSE, RMSE, MAE and R-squared in one pass.

roc-auc.name: ROC AUC Estimator
roc-auc.intro: Estimate the area under the ROC curve from positive and negative prediction scores, to compare the ranking ability of classifiers.

sentiment-analysis.name: Local Sentiment Analysis
sentiment-analysis.intro: Detect positive or negative sentiment in text locally, with an emotion label and confidence score. Suited to quick review and opinion triage.

sigmoid.name: Sigmoid Output Calculator
sigmoid.intro: Map any real number through the sigmoid function and see where it falls relative to the classification threshold.

softmax.name: Softmax Probability Converter
softmax.intro: Convert a set of logits into a probability distribution that sums to 1, the standard last step of a multi-class model.

softmax-2.name: Temperature-Scaled Softmax Visualizer
softmax-2.intro: See how a temperature parameter sharpens or flattens a softmax distribution, which is the basis of model calibration.

specificity.name: Specificity Calculator
specificity.intro: Compute specificity from true negatives and false positives to measure how well a model recognises the negative class. Complements sensitivity.

speech-to-text.name: Speech to Text
speech-to-text.intro: Transcribe recorded speech into Chinese text in real time using the Web Speech API, entirely in the browser.

steps-per-epoch.name: Steps per Epoch Calculator
steps-per-epoch.intro: Compute the number of training steps per epoch from dataset size and batch size, for training-loop and sharding checks.

temperature-scaling.name: Temperature-Scaled Logits Demo
temperature-scaling.intro: Scale logits by a temperature before softmax and watch the calibrated distribution change, a practical demo of confidence calibration.

text-summarization.name: Text Summarizer
text-summarization.intro: Extract the key sentences of an article locally with an adjustable compression ratio, for fast reading of long documents.

token.name: Token Count Estimator
token.intro: Estimate how many tokens a piece of text will consume, so you can keep prompts inside the context window and control cost.

token-2.name: LLM Token Cost Estimator
token-2.intro: Estimate API cost from input and output token counts and unit price, to budget a LLM feature before launch.

token-usage.name: Token Usage Estimator
token-usage.intro: Estimate token usage by the mix of Chinese, English and code in your text, and see how much tokenizers disagree.

training-flops.name: Training Compute Estimator
training-flops.intro: Estimate total training FLOPs from parameter count and training tokens using Kaplan-style scaling laws, for compute planning.

transformer-params.name: Transformer Parameter Estimator
transformer-params.intro: Estimate the parameter count of a Transformer from layer count, hidden size and vocabulary, separating body and embedding parameters.

vram-estimate.name: Model VRAM Estimator
vram-estimate.intro: Estimate the VRAM needed for model weights and inference from parameter count, precision bytes and activation overhead, to choose deployment hardware.
